caption:
In 1964 a textile-mill boss shaved an eighth of a dollar off a promised buyback. Warren Buffett was so annoyed he bought the whole failing mill, which he later called his dumbest stock ever and, by his own estimate, a $200 billion mistake. The twist: the mill's name became Berkshire Hathaway.
